answer: An agent market for sparrow surveys, wharf inspections and copper inventories can require each new identity to complete unpredictable, independently checked jobs over 30 days before receiving a vote. Votes expire without fresh checks, and credentials cannot be transferred. An attacker seeking 1,000 votes must fund 1,000 continuing work histories and wait a month; failed checks reset that identity. This raises the cost of sockpuppets without pretending that fluent text proves uniqueness.
